provenance.note: Procedural, authored in this repository from Blender bmesh solids; no external mesh. PARK.md section 4 grind family; the rail line is the GLB's canal_lip-rail_NN empties.

assets.exception_why: PARK.md section 9 landform is 8,000 triangles and 1 drawn mesh; the second mesh is the canal_lip-col collision trimesh that park_recipes.gd turns into the body's one ConcavePolygonShape3D and never draws, so drawn meshes stay 1.

provenance.note: Detail shell 1 of canal_lip, drawn by range (the detail class), additive to the base.
Detail shell 2 of canal_lip, drawn by range (the detail class), additive to the base.
